plot: On the morning of the Park Pet Show Dog is covered in mud and runs from the bath; Max's soap chase only lands him in the puddle, then Mouse notices Dog loves water, and Max discovers Dog is scared of the hose's loud hiss, so they fill the tub quietly with buckets and a floating red ball, Dog jumps in happily, and his shake leaves Max soaked and fluffy just before the show whose poster shows two paws.

beats.say: Max! Good morning! Look at me! I'm a chocolate dog!
Dog shakes. Splat! Splat! Mud flies all over Max.
Dog! The Pet Show is today! How do we get you clean?
It's the morning after the storm. The garden is one big puddle.
Easy. One bath, some soap, and Dog is shiny again.
Here's the blue tub, dears. I'll fill it with the hose.
Grandma turns on the garden hose. Ssssssss!
Dog jumps high in the air and runs behind the tree.
Bath? Who said bath? I don't know any dog called Dog.
Dog, please! Muddy dogs can't go in the Pet Show!
Then I'll be a tree. Trees don't need baths. I'm a tree.
Trees don't bark, Dog. And trees don't have muddy tails.
This tree has a muddy tail. It's a special tree.
Okay. Plan one. I grab the soap and catch him.
Max runs at Dog. Dog runs around the tree.
Round and round and round. Dog is very fast.
Got you! No! Got you! No! Where did you go?
Max slips and lands bottom-first in the big mud puddle.
Eww! Now I'm a chocolate cat! And cats hate getting wet!
Ha! Now we match! Two chocolate friends!
Then Dog jumps right into the puddle with Max. Splash!
Wait a minute. Did you all see that?
Dog loves the puddle. He jumped in on purpose!
So Dog is not scared of water. Not one bit.
Then why does he run away from the bath?
The show starts after lunch. Dog has to be clean by then.
Or Dog can't be in the show! Let's find out why.
Max and Mouse look at everything like real detectives.
The tub. Water. A puddle. Water. Both the same.
The soap smells like roses. Dog likes roses. He sniffs them.
So it's not the water. And it's not the soap.
Is the tub too small? Dog is a big dog.
No. Last summer he napped in it. All afternoon.
Grandma turns the hose on again to finish filling the tub.
Ssssssss! And behind the tree, Dog's ears go flat.
Did you see that? He hides when the hose goes sss!
Dog, are you scared of the hose noise?
It goes SSSS. Like a big angry cat. A giant one.
I'm a cat. And I'm not angry. I'm just muddy.
Yes, but you don't go SSSS for a whole minute.
So no hose! We fill the tub a quiet way!
No hose? Really? Not even a tiny sss?
Not even a tiny one. Cat promise.
I have a watering can and two little buckets.
So they carry water. Slosh, slosh. No hissing at all.
Mouse carries a tiny cup. It takes a very long time.
Twelve cups. Thirteen cups. Okay, a big bucket is faster.
The tub is full! It looks just like a puddle now.
A quiet puddle? Hmm. It still looks a bit like a bath.
Then here's one more thing. Your favorite red ball!
Max throws the red ball. Plop! It floats in the tub.
My ball! I'm coming, ball! Here I come!
Dog jumps in. Water everywhere. Bubbles everywhere.
Hey! A bath is just a puddle with a ball in it!
Mouse rubs the soap. Max scrubs Dog's ears. Scrub, scrub.
Look at that. He's not a chocolate dog anymore.
Dog is clean and shiny. Then he shakes. Shake, shake, shake!
Water flies all over Max. Now he is clean and soaking wet.
Brrr! I'm wet! Every hair on me is sticking up!
You look like a big orange dandelion, Max.
A dandelion? Today? On the day of the Pet Show?
Don't worry, dear. The sun will dry you. Mostly.
Thank you, Max. You found out what scared me.
When a friend is scared, first find out why.
Then you can help them in a way that works.
Lunch is ready! Then off to the Pet Show!
Max, the show poster has a picture of two paws. Why two?
Two paws? Never mind. But who is going to dry ME?

long.title: Can Max Get Muddy Dog Into the Bath? 🛁🐶
long.description:
"I just wanted Dog clean for the show... so why am I the one in the mud?" 🐱
On the morning of the Park Pet Show, Dog is covered in mud and runs from the bath. Max and Mouse play detective to find out what Dog is really afraid of. Max the Curious Cat, Ep 20.
